description: Fix backend order creation to handle inline addressData from checkout. The frontend sends addressData: { recipientName, phone, street, city, province, postalCode } but the backend only reads addressId. This FEAT extends the order service and controller to accept addressData, map camelCase fields to snake_case, create an Address record inside the transaction, and use the new address ID on the order. FEAT-002 is independent of FEAT-001 (different files). Both should complete before FEAT-003.
steps: Edit d:/Tugas Kuliah/UAS-CC/backend/src/services/order.service.ts — add AddressData interface with fields recipient_name, phone, street, city, province, postal_code; extend CreateOrderInput to include addressData?: AddressData; inside createOrder(), before the $transaction, resolve address: if addressId provided use it, else if addressData provided create Address record inside the tx and use its id; replace hardcoded input.addressId with resolvedAddressId

Edit d:/Tugas Kuliah/UAS-CC/backend/src/controllers/order.controller.ts createOrder() — destructure addressData from req.body; map camelCase frontend fields to snake_case: { recipient_name: req.body.addressData?.recipientName, phone: req.body.addressData?.phone, street: req.body.addressData?.street, city: req.body.addressData?.city, province: req.body.addressData?.province, postal_code: req.body.addressData?.postalCode }; pass mapped addressData to orderService.createOrder
Run: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit to confirm 0 errors
acceptance_criteria: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit exits with code 0
order.service.ts creates an Address record inside $transaction when addressData is provided and addressId is absent
order.controller.ts maps addressData from camelCase (frontend) to snake_case (service)
